purpose: Trace path for Middleware V3: Middleware OTel SDK -> per-host collector agent (loopback OTLP) -> central gateway (mutual TLS) -> Tempo. W3C traceparent/tracestate are preserved end to end; correlation.id is normalised and bounded; every credential class is scrubbed before export.

v3_candidate_observed.authority: informational only; unmerged, owned by the Middleware V3 session

path.producer: Middleware OTel SDK (traces, logs, metrics over OTLP)
path.agent: codestra/collector-agent.yaml: receivers otlp 127.0.0.1:4317/4318 only; processors memory_limiter, attributes/redact, transform/secret_shaped, batch; exporter otlp/gateway (mTLS from /run/secrets, file-backed queue)
path.gateway: codestra/collector.yaml: resource/codestra, attributes/redact, filter/required_identity, filter/tenant_safe, transform/traces, transform/correlation, tail_sampling, batch -> Tempo (OTLP, TLS, X-Scope-OrgID)
path.storage: Codestra-Tempo (traces), Codestra-Loki (logs), Codestra-Prometheus (metrics via remote write / scrape)

rules: the collector never rewrites trace_id, span_id or parent_span_id (no OTTL set() on trace context fields)
Middleware echoes a valid inbound traceparent, drops an invalid one and mints a new context when absent (app/core/request_guard.py at the prep base)
asynchronous hops (outbox -> worker -> adapter) use span links to the originating span
X-Correlation-ID becomes span/log attribute correlation.id (<= 128 chars) in transform/correlation; metrics never carry it

required_common_fields.deployment_sha: resource deployment.id (git sha of the running image)
required_common_fields.operation_id: span/log attribute codestra.operation.id (bounded opaque; never a metric label; never a Loki label)
required_common_fields.trace_id: OTLP trace context (native), mirrored to logs as trace_id/span_id

v3_span_coverage.note: one per inbound request; the W3C traceparent from Kong/Caddy is the parent
span link from dispatch to the enqueueing span
acquire/renew/expire; lease ids never as attributes
one per provider call; provider credentials never present

redaction.attribute_keys_deleted: exact list plus any key ending in password/passwd/secret/token/api_key/apikey/private_key/credential(s)/dsn/database_url/connection_string/signing_key/access_key/client_secret
values_scrubbed: key=value credential pairs in log bodies

v3_expectations: Middleware V3 instruments the ten kernel stages above with the listed low-cardinality attributes
Kong and Caddy propagate traceparent so a TEST_SYN operation is one trace from edge to adapter (Codestra-Tempo trace-propagation-contract.v1.json)
Re-pin middleware.v3_final_sha and replay a V3 trace sample through scripts/validate_middleware_v3_trace_pipeline.py
